correctness.rationale: The full primary paper's Theorems 2.1 and 2.2 reduce any non-power-of-x solution to a cyclotomic product with Phi_1 present. The degree bound leaves indices 1,2,3,4,6. Enumerating the bounded exponent vectors gives exactly twelve cyclotomic cores and thirteen degree-four polynomials after x-power multiples.

value.rationale: The general all-prime problem in the primary paper is only partially characterized. Degree four is the first layer in which the exceptional Phi_6 term can be tested together with the Phi_2 factor required by its local divisibility at p=3; the same degree bound also captures the first surviving Phi_4-Phi_2 interaction. Exact local tests distinguish necessary cyclotomic forms from those that actually work. This is a complete motivated base classification for any later all-degree criterion, not a claim to solve the general problem.
